mission.name: IDC Forge 2.0.4 World-Class Trust and Utility
mission.tagline: Externalize first trust, close every parser seam, and release fifty skills only on recomputable proof.
mission.northStar: A new consumer can reject a counterfeit repository without trusting it to define its own root; every parser, waiver, credential, provenance, platform, and release claim is independently recomputable.

policies.notes: The owner authorized execution of the 2.0.4 G0-G6 plan. GitHub remains canonical distribution. A company-site trust and discovery channel is planned, but its exact deployment target, independent custody, and publication proof remain separate G1/G6 acceptance actions. No force-push, credential disclosure, evidence rewriting, or unrelated mutation is authorized.

risks.title: Several requested harnesses may not expose a native Agent Skills loader
risks.note: Buzz and Grok Bot remain unsupported/unknown, native-Windows Hermes has a failed observation, and several authenticated behavior probes remain partial or unrun. The matrix does not invent installation paths.

risks.title: 2.0.4 production root ceremony and independent publication are pending
risks.note: Code can implement and test threshold-root behavior, but authorized human key holders must conduct the production ceremony and publish the initial root through at least two separately administered channels. The company-site endpoint and deployment evidence are not yet specified.

risks.title: Guard and scanner are bounded defense-in-depth controls
risks.note: The accepted 325-case guard and 607-case scanner matrices are red-capable for their documented surfaces, but they are not a shell sandbox or a general language-runtime proof. Signed content, signed waiver authority, sealed-load execution, and external freshness remain separate gates.

risks.title: The complete current pack is intentionally blocked from claude.ai export
risks.note: Current public documentation imposes a 200-character description limit and does not establish an explicit-only equivalent for thirteen user-invoked islands. No live upload or routing probe was run; this is not a native 2.0.3 release claim.

risks.title: Whole-run rollback stops at the unexpected-I/O boundary
risks.note: Every destination is preflighted and each skill replacement is atomic, but a multi-skill or multi-target run is not rollback-atomic after an unexpected mid-run I/O failure.

risks.title: Trusted bootstrap cannot be established by repository code
risks.note: A consumer must compare the signing-key fingerprint through a trusted out-of-band channel before executing the verifier. Five green checks without that bootstrap do not establish authorship.

risks.title: First requested video's visual channel is unavailable
risks.note: Transcript extraction succeeded, but YouTube rejected source-video retrieval. The report makes no frame or screen claim.

risks.title: Historical ICM fusion commit remains unpinned
risks.note: The live head and MIT license are recorded, but no current revision is substituted for the missing fusion-time source commit or archive.

nextActions: Implement and falsify the G0 evidence schema and dependency-free validator against the preserved Kimi package.
Reconcile every 2.0.3 finding to an exact revision, path, line range, fixture digest, command, output digest, and unambiguous disposition.
Advance to G1 only after the complete evidence package and negative fixtures prove the validator red-capable.
blockers: The production G1 root ceremony requires authorized threshold-key holders; no signing secret may enter the repository, shell history, chat, or evidence bundle.

The company-site trust endpoint, independent administrative custody, and deployment proof must be supplied before G1/G6 production acceptance; implementation can proceed without inventing those facts.
Real Windows/NTFS/OpenSSH and final macOS/Bash 3.2 runs must be bound to the exact candidate before G4/G6 acceptance.
Exact-head independent review, blind Kimi rerun, protected CI, merge, tag, publication, and reinstall remain downstream G6 gates.
Current claude.ai export remains blocked by 48 over-limit descriptions and 13 user-only invocation semantics; this product limitation is not a blocker for the native 2.0.3 candidate.
The first requested video's source frames remain unavailable after YouTube 403/reload failures; transcript evidence is complete and no visual claim is made.
The historical ICM fusion commit remains unknown; the live head and license are recorded without substituting current provenance for missing historical evidence.
conventions: ops/mission/state.json is the source of truth; never hand-edit state-of-the-union.html.
Positive harness claims require an authoritative source and reproducible probe.
Canonical skill bytes are preserved unless a red-capable evaluation justifies an edit.
Worktree evidence is draft evidence until re-derived from a fresh clone.
A historical compatibility transform preserves metadata values only; it never asserts invocation semantics.
The public-key fingerprint must be confirmed out of band before repository code is trusted; a repository green light cannot bootstrap its own authorship.

Any signed skill, policy, verifier, installer, hook, workflow, report, state, journal, or other controlled-byte change after final signing invalidates the release and requires manifest regeneration plus a new signature.

GitHub is the canonical code and release channel. A company site is a discovery and independent trust channel only when its administrative custody and publication path do not merely repeat repository-controlled data.
An external site is not required for skill execution; it is required for the selected two-channel first-contact trust design unless a different genuinely independent channel is accepted.

G0-G6 implementation is authorized. Merge policy remains review, and production threshold signing, company-site deployment, tag, and release publication stay separately evidenced acceptance actions. A failed signature, clean-clone, CI, trust-root, public-source, semantic, or installed-byte check stops the sequence; force-push and unrelated mutation remain unauthorized.
